title: Profesia job monitor config
description: Read from config.json by default. Every search is scraped and merged into the same jobs file. Filter values are documented in salvage.md.

out.description: Jobs file. Relative paths resolve against the config file's folder.

pages.description: Max listing pages per search (20 offers per page).

interval.description: Minutes between scrapes. The script runs forever; use --once for a single run.

count_days.description: Only offers posted in the last N days (any whole number works). Offers expire after ~31 days, so 31+ equals no filter. Top-level value applies to every search; a search's own count_days overrides it.

telegram.description: Telegram notifications. Users subscribe by sending /start to the bot and unsubscribe with /stop.

token.description: Bot token from @BotFather. Null falls back to the TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN env var; with neither, notifications are off. Keep it out of git.

subscribers.description: Subscriber list and update offset. Relative paths resolve against the config file's folder.

provider.description: LLM backend. The matching langchain-* package must be installed and the provider's API key present in the env (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY).

name.description: Model id. null uses the per-provider default: anthropic=claude-sonnet-4-5, openai=gpt-4o-mini, google=gemini-2.5-flash.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. 0 is recommended for consistent verdicts.

max_tokens.description: Max output tokens (mapped to max_output_tokens for the google provider).

segments.description: Path filters: region (bratislavsky-kraj), position (programator-programatorka), employment type (plny-uvazok), work area (informacne-technologie), company type (zamestnavatelia), language (anglicky-jazyk).

remote_work.description: 0 = on-site only, 1 = remote only, 2 = partially remote, null = any.

min_salary.description: Minimum salary in EUR. Site presets: monthly 600-2500, hourly 4-15.

salary_period.description: m = monthly, h = hourly. Only used with min_salary.

count_days.description: Overrides the top-level count_days for this search.
